content: iOS Safari does not allow JavaScript to set HTMLMediaElement.volume on <audio>/<video> elements — reads always return 1, writes are silently ignored, because Apple keeps audio level under the user's physical hardware control on iOS. Desktop Safari (macOS) DOES honor .volume normally; only iOS is affected. This is long-standing, documented behavior, not a bug that gets fixed. Confirmed via MDN compat data and Apple's own HTML5 Audio/Video device-specific-considerations doc.
